source_text.body:
Publish a blog post on a Wix Studio site
Operator logged into Wix Studio, found the draft blog post, and asked the user to confirm before publishing.
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
ChatGPT Operator opened its Chrome-like browser and went to the Wix Studio login page. It asked the user to enter their credentials. After login it found the draft blog post by itself. Before publishing, it asked the user to confirm.
How it went
The source reports the blog-publishing flow working, with no numbers. It does say Operator struggled with finer styling changes, such as font weight on a menu, in other tests.
Worth knowing
Operator needs a ChatGPT Pro subscription ($200) and a US location. The source says a VPN can get around the location requirement.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Log into my Wix Studio site at [site name or URL], open the blog manager and find the draft post titled [post title]. Check that the title, featured image and formatting look right, then tell me about any problems you see. Do not click Publish until you have shown me the post and I have explicitly confirmed. Once I confirm, publish it and give me the live link.
Original source: https://dicloak.com/blog-detail/i-tried-openai-new-chatgpt-agent---operator-for-web-design
